page.layout: One column of running text, with three centred headings in larger type. Running head at the top. No page number or catchword is printed. A small mark sits at the bottom left edge, probably a stray scan mark, and is not transcribed.

main_text.p: Christum esse virtute & natura inferiorem Melchisedeco, Melchisedeciani.
Christum Patri ὁμοιούσιον tantum, Acatiani, Samiarriani, Macedoniani.
Diuinam Christi naturam quædam ignorafse, Agnoetæ.
Diuinam naturam in Christo fuisse tantum post incarnationem, Monophysitæ.
main_text.head: Dominum nostrum.
main_text.p: Caput Ecclesiæ præter Christum, Papam constituunt Papistæ.
main_text.head: Conceptum ex Spiritu sancto.
main_text.p: Christum conceptum ex concubitu ad morem caeterorum hominum afferunt Carpocratiani:
Ex Iosephi & Mariæ coitu, Ebionitæ, Cerinthiani, Theodotiani.
main_text.head: Natum ex Maria virgine.
main_text.p: Christum in carne venisse & hominem factum negant Simoniani, Christolytæ, Proclitæ.
Christum duntaxat fuisse hominem, sed propter maiores progressus virtutum perfectiorem caeteris, Ebionitæ, Cerinthiani, Artemonitæ, Alogi, Theodotiani, Melchisedeciani, Manichæi.

page.notes: Greek words in the first lines (ὁμοιούσιον, ὑπερούσιον, ἀνόμοιον) are uncertain; the Greek on the scan is faint and the accents and letters may differ. The Greek after "Alogi" is printed in Latin letters ("Alo-gy") and is copied as shown. The page number is not printed. Long s is copied as s; "fuisse" is shown in its normal spelling from the printed "fuiffe".
